question.text: Two dice are thrown together 4 times. The probability that both dice will show same numbers twice is -

solution.text:
(c) The probability of showing same number by both dice $p=\frac{6}{36}=\frac{1}{6}$
In binomial distribution here $n=4, r=2, p=$
$\begin{array}{l}
\frac{1}{6}, \mathrm{q}=\frac{5}{6} \\
\text { req. probability }={ }^{n} C_{r} q^{n-r} p^{r}={ }^{4} C_{2}\left(\frac{5}{6}\right)^{2}\left(\frac{1}{6}\right)^{2} \\
=6\left(\frac{25}{36}\right)\left(\frac{1}{36}\right)=\frac{25}{216}
\end{array}$
